---
title: "Module 03 — Actor-oriented Picos"
---

## Actor model (only what is needed)

```
          message
             │
             ▼
        ┌─────────┐
        │  Pico   │
        │  state  │
        └─────────┘
             │
             ▼
          response
```

## Properties

| Property | Pico meaning |
|----------|--------------|
| Identity | Addressable Pico id |
| Encapsulated state | Only the Pico mutates its state |
| Message handling | `invoke(event, payload)` |
| Serialized execution | One event at a time per identity |
| Location transparency | Caller need not know which machine |
| Lifecycle independence | State can outlive a process |

## Exercise

Explain in one paragraph why `hello-pico/alice` and `hello-pico/bob` are different Picos even when they share the same code.
